title: LG LRMVS — Main PCB test mode
description: Main PCB test button: ×1 all loads, ×2 damper closed, ×3 forced defrost.

steps.title: Test Mode 1 — all loads
steps.body: Push main PCB test button once: compressor, damper, and all fans run (all display segments on). Fan voltage checks use CON3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Push main PCB test button once: compressor, damper, and all fans run (all display segments on). Fan voltage checks use CON3.

steps.title: Test Mode 2 — damper closed
steps.body: Push test button twice: damper closed (display shows 22 22).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Push test button twice: damper closed (display shows 22 22).

steps.title: Test Mode 3 — forced defrost
steps.body: Push test button three times: forced defrost (display shows 33 33). Defrost heater voltage at CON9.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Push test button three times: forced defrost (display shows 33 33). Defrost heater voltage at CON9.
